title: Weak-model verification output contract (verification mode)
description: JSON counterpart of the markdown verification template checked by scripts/check_ai_protocol.py --mode verification. Each property is the line content of the corresponding markdown section, as an array of strings. Aligned checks: all four sections required; an empty 'verification_run' requires a 'not verified' entry in 'failures_not_verified' (checker code); a success claim without command evidence requires an explicit NOT VERIFIED entry (checker code); total lines must not exceed the verification budget of 8 (LINE_BUDGETS.verification); forbidden noise phrases rejected.

verification_run.description: Verification run: commands actually executed with their result; empty is allowed only with a NOT VERIFIED explanation.

result.description: Result: pass/fail summary of the verification.

failures_not_verified.description: Failures / NOT VERIFIED: failures, or explicit 'not verified: <why>' entries.

next_action.description: Next action: what happens next (review, fix, escalate).
